newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chiwan Petroleum '96 net falls 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chiwan Petroleum '96 net falls 20 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.24 yuan vs 0.29 yuan
Net assets per share 2.04 yuan vs 1.98 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Chiwan Petroleum Supply Base Co Ltd .
Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards.

Based on international standards, the company posted net profits of US$6.65 million for 1996, the report said but gave no comparative figure. The company's 1995 net profits, based on international standards, were US$8.17 million.
The firm's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of US$0.02 per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 20, the report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
